## Scope

Stacked directly on draft PR #182 (`58b13b1644726bb307ea3e58461c7c0a970215f9`). This follow-up publishes exact commit `51f4a38e2e43d6ff050db08e3235b2b447b708cf`.

- Forward the already injected `fetchImpl` into the multi-run registry.
- Preserve the producer's `NATIVE_EXECUTION_KICKOFF_UNKNOWN` diagnostic code.
- Add one focused test for each correction.

No deployment manifest, credential, CA material, Core HTTP behavior, or live task changes are included.

## Verification

- `git diff --check 58b13b16..51f4a38e` passed.
- `node --test apps/runtime/test/runner-kickoff-diagnostic.test.mjs`: 1 passed, 0 failed on Node 22.23.3.
- `node --test apps/runtime/test/prepared-candidate-fetch-propagation.test.mjs`: blocked before its assertion because this checkout lacks `@js-temporal/polyfill`. This is not counted as a pass.

Node 24/Fargate trust IO, live startup, and a fresh chat remain unverified. The existing deployment and chat hold remains in force. This PR is source-only and draft.
